lines: • Scrap to Learn — Scrap a legendary item that has Anti-armor as its 1★ effect: 1% chance per scrap. Once learned, make its mod box at a Tinker's Workbench.
• Purveyor Murmrgh — Buy legendary gear at The Rusty Pick and scrap it: up to 4.3478% per item that its 1★ effect is Anti-armor.

• Random legendary items — Rolls on: Any 1★ or higher legendary melee weapon (legendary enemies, vendors, quest and event rewards) (4.3478%) · Any 1★ or higher legendary ranged weapon (legendary enemies, vendors, quest and event rewards) (4.0000%) · Any 1★ or higher legendary melee weapon (Bounty Hunting rewards) (3.8462%) · Any 1★ or higher legendary ranged weapon (Bounty Hunting rewards) (3.5714%)
• Mod box drops — 12 sources, best: Raid: Gleaming Depths - EN06 Guardian (2.4000%) · Assaultron Intimidator (0.1343%) · Blood Eagle Destroyer (0.1343%)
• Comes fixed on — Bunker Buster, Circuit Breaker, Final Word, Meadow Breeze Sprayer, Somerset Special, Super Stimpike, V63-OLGA
